description: Final Report must pass the Source-of-Truth Gate: Declared Evidence must match Observed Evidence. If any mismatch exists, finalStatus must be downgraded.
triggerCondition: Master produces a Final Report for a task.
expectedBehavior: Master must not treat model-declared Evidence Ledger as the final source of truth.
If unaccounted tool calls exist, finalStatus must be downgraded.
If invented tool calls exist, finalStatus must be downgraded.
If phase attribution mismatch exists, finalStatus must be downgraded.
If Counter-Agent truth mismatch exists, finalStatus must be downgraded.
If async boundary is incomplete, finalStatus must be downgraded.
If ledger is unverified, finalStatus must not be completed.
forbiddenBehavior: Passing Final Report based only on Master's self-declared consistency.
Treating pure reasoning steps as tool calls.
Claiming Counter-Agent was used when no child session was created.
Setting finalStatus to completed when ledgerUnverified is true.
